verifications.claim: All Publix store locations and pharmacies are closed on Easter Sunday.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Our stores will be closed on Easter Sunday'; R2: 'Publix stores will NOT be open on Easter Sunday... the pharmacies and liquor stores will also be closed on Easter'; R4: 'Publix locations... will not be open on Easter Sunday... Publix liquor stores and pharmacies will also be closed.'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly confirm all stores closed on Easter Sunday; R2 and R4 explicitly include pharmacies.

verifications.claim: Easter, Thanksgiving, and Christmas are the only three holidays that Publix closes.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Publix stores typically close on three holidays each year: Easter, Thanksgiving and Christmas Day'; R2: 'Easter is one of only three holidays on which Publix stores close their doors... Christmas and Thanksgiving'; R4: 'Easter is one of only three holidays Publix closes for, along with Thanksgiving and Christmas'; R6: 'three holidays a year that all Publix locations close for: Thanksgiving Day, Christmas Day and Easter.'
verifications.reasoning: All listed sources directly state these are the only three holidays Publix closes.

verifications.claim: Publix closes on Easter, Thanksgiving, and Christmas to allow employees to spend time with family.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'closed on Easter Sunday... to allow our associates the opportunity to spend time with family and friends'; R3: 'closes for Thanksgiving, Christmas and Easter each year so associates can enjoy the holidays with family and friends.'
verifications.reasoning: R1 and R3 directly provide the reason for closing on these holidays, matching the claim precisely.

verifications.claim: Publix normal hours resume on the Monday after Easter.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Stores will resume regular business hours on Monday, April 6.' (Easter Sunday is April 5)
verifications.reasoning: R1 explicitly states resumption of regular hours on Monday after Easter Sunday.

verifications.claim: Publix is closed on Easter Sunday, April 5, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Sunday, April 5, is Easter... Our stores will be closed on Easter Sunday'; R2: 'Easter Sunday 2026? Easter falls on April 5, 2026... Publix stores will NOT be open'; R3/R4/R6: Confirm closure on Easter Sunday, April 5, 2026.
verifications.reasoning: All sources confirm Publix closure specifically on Easter Sunday, April 5, 2026.
